name: 1mind
tagline: AI 'Superhumans' with a face and voice that sell across the funnel.
description: 1mind builds AI 'Superhumans' — digital go-to-market teammates with a photorealistic face, a voice, and deep product knowledge that engage buyers 24/7 across websites, live video calls, product tours, and deal rooms. They qualify leads, deliver demos, handle objections, and onboard customers without human handoffs. The company launched publicly in late 2025 and counts HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and Nutanix among early customers.
insight: Founded by Amanda Kahlow, who earlier founded and led ABM pioneer 6sense; launched publicly in Nov 2025 with $40M.
edge: Gives each AI 'Superhuman' a photorealistic face and voice that can join live video sales calls and run demos — not just text or voice chat.
pros: Works across web, calls, and deal rooms

references.title: 1mind Launched With $40 Million to Advance AI-Led Sales
